final: SELECT SUM(state_total) as total_invoice_sum, AVG(invoice_count) as avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT COALESCE(c.State, 'NULL') as State, SUM(i.Total) as state_total, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) as invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY COALESCE(c.State, 'NULL'))
